relations.subject: V.I. Subramoniam
relations.role: emeritus professor of Tamil Language and Literature and later of Linguistics
relations.evidence: V.I. Subramoniam (Vadasery Iyemperumal Subramoniam) (b. 1926) is emeritus professor of Tamil Language and Literature and later of Linguistics, University of Kerala, Thiruvananthapuram

relations.subject: V.I. Subramoniam
relations.evidence: is currently Honorary Director and founding member of the International School of Dravidian Linguistics, Thiruvananthapuram.

relations.subject: V.I. Subramoniam
relations.role: M.A. in Tamil Language and Literature
relations.evidence: He received his M.A. in Tamil Language and Literature from the Annamalai University

relations.subject: V.I. Subramoniam
relations.evidence: and his Ph.D. from the Indiana University, U.S.A.

relations.subject: V.I. Subramoniam
relations.evidence: He was the first Vice-Chancellor of the Tamil University, Tanjavur.

relations.subject: V.I. Subramoniam
relations.evidence: His efforts to establish a Dravidian University in Kuppam, Andhra Pradesh resulted in the creation of a university there

relations.subject: V.I. Subramoniam
relations.evidence: and he was its first Pro-Chancellor.
